pull_request.title: Infrastructure: account calorimeter software-chain tokens separately
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-token-accounting
pull_request.body:
The recent calorimeter software-chain work was already counted in #59, but its eight closed turns were grouped with material-tool tasks. Give it a dedicated canonical accounting record with a visible per-turn breakdown: **27,882,303 input + 195,220 output = 28,077,523 tokens**. Cached input 27,035,136 and reasoning output 69,214 are subsets.

Move the eight complete usage entries unchanged from the mixed desktop backfill record to `SESSION-2026-10-10-calorimeter-software-chain`; the former owner keeps its two material-tool turns. Retain the original recovery inventory byte-for-byte and add a dated ownership correction. Fresh usage-only recovery corroborates all five counters, request digests and persisted closed boundaries.

The work covers the research plan, ActsExamples feasibility, foundation, seeded clustering, FastJet jets and EDM4hep IO/persistence (asalzburger/acts PR4–8). All confirmed development turns in this scope completed on October 10. Later accounting/dashboard turns and the active current turn are excluded from this development subtotal.

**No new tokens are added:** the whole project remains at **552,937,331 observed tokens across 183 unique turns**. This is an attribution update, preventing double counting. Only journal/accounting files change; software, dependencies, detector design and dashboard code are untouched.

Validation: 33 logging/recovery/link tests pass; 153 paired records validate; the ownership comparison preserves all original entries and all five project totals; project validation and the current main dashboard build pass (58 tasks / 31 documents / 19 reviews); whitespace checks pass. No native software rerun or scientific approval is claimed.

The user asked whether PR62 needs rebasing after PR63 merged. Started from
PR62 head `229e02aaddfe450af695dc221c624d7eaaf529c7` on
`infrastructure/device-accounting-sync-20261012`; the four unrelated untracked
token-gate files remain untouched. PR63 merged into main as
`2534ae86e89a10894ed3e7c47f3a83d451774de6`, including the PR61 calorimeter
ownership correction. GitHub showed PR62 as mergeable with passing old-dashboard
CI, but that did not validate the newly introduced token-site workflow.

Read the changed repository instructions and current token/project validation
guides. An ordinary merge in an isolated checkout was conflict-free but the new
token collector failed against the combined records. The branch therefore needs
a compatibility correction, despite having no textual merge conflict. The
repository requires ordinary merges, so shared history is preserved.
